findings.evidence: RC9's gJbTrustcacheLock serializes its append/clear operations but not trustcache_file_upload or kernel readers. Same-size updates write in place; size changes unlink and free after a fixed 10ms delay. The fixed official and ZQBB references share this pattern.
findings.required_before_fix: Prove kernel reader synchronization and allocation reclamation semantics; a user-space mutex or longer sleep is not sufficient.

findings.evidence: RC9 rolls back synchronous move failures, but no startup journal restores dyld if execution stops after patched dyld moves to dyld.old and before inflight dyld publishes at dyld.
findings.fallback: On the next explicit app jailbreak, prepareBootstrap republishes the app-bundled basebin before loadBasebinTrustcache; later jailbreak steps regenerate patched dyld. This is a user-triggered whole-bundle reset, not automatic journal recovery, and can roll back a live update to the bundled version.
findings.test_gap: Current dyld tests inject returned filesystem errors, not process termination and restart between each publish operation.

findings.evidence: jbupdate_basebin validates a staged payload but replaces live top-level entries by remove-then-copy. Version markers are process environment only; no durable per-item backup/journal restores a partial batch.
findings.distinct_from: DOBootstrapper stage/ready/backup is not the live updater's automatic journal or rollback. On the next explicit app jailbreak, it republishes the app-bundled basebin before trustcache load, providing a user-triggered whole-bundle reset that may roll back a live update.
findings.test_gap: Current updater tests inject synchronous remove/copy errors but do not assert rollback of earlier items or model termination mid-transaction.

required_closure: If automatic interruption recovery is required, design a durable, idempotent journal before changing runtime publication behavior; otherwise document the manual bundled-basebin reset and its rollback consequence.
Inject termination after every update mutation and verify the selected recovery path before launchd consumes basebin or dyld.
Preserve active dyld vnode, fakelib mount and RootHide path semantics.

phase_eight.scope: Generated-dyld helper API parity and the legacy Corellium standalone call path.

The standard iOS app path uses basebin_generate and was not affected by this missing helper.
finding.change: Restore the parameterized helper and header declaration; keep RC9's checked filesystem operations and immediate move-error rollback; preserve basebin_generate as a wrapper using /usr/lib and the active jbroot basebin.
finding.test: tests/test_rc9_dyld.py source contract for declaration, definition, standalone caller and wrapper

limits: The public TIPA workflow does not compile the Corellium standalone target.
This API restoration does not close generated-dyld process-interruption recovery.
No product version, minimum iOS target or device support claim changed.

changes: Propagate kernel reads and writes through trustcache list traversal and mutation.

limits: The 10ms retirement delay is not proof that kernel trustcache readers have quiesced.

phase_ten.scope: Guard signature re-encoding failure in trust_signatures without changing the successful attachment path.

finding.evidence: Both comparison paths dereference the result of csd_superblob_encode without checking it. RC9 additionally frees the original signature buffer before encoding, so an allocation failure could cause a null dereference and discard the original buffer.
finding.change: Encode to a temporary first; preserve the original allocation on failure, clean up local state and return the existing -2 allocation-failure status. Replace the original only after successful encoding.
finding.test: tests/test_rc9_signature_attachment.py extracts the production trust_signatures function and injects encode failure and success.

limits: The added guard is a local failure-path hardening, not an upstream backport.
It does not close remaining signature parser/attachment paths or trustcache kernel-reader lifetime.

Stop on code-directory hash failure before querying or publishing hashes; free temporary state and return the existing generic -1 failure.

phase_thirteen.scope: Fixed ChOma outer-container boundaries, real codec allocation failures and known-size trust consumer.
changes: Validate outer header, declared length, index table and child ranges against actual supplied capacity.
